{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataEnum_GeneratedFormatter_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80References = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var messagePackReferences = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n\n        const string externalSource = \"\"\"\nnamespace ExternalLib\n{\n    public enum ExternalEnum\n    {\n        None = 0,\n        First = 1,\n        Second = 2,\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation externalCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ExternalAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(externalSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            net80References,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = externalCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference externalReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray());\n\n        const string consumerSource = \"\"\"\nusing ExternalLib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace ConsumerApp\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public ExternalEnum Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation consumerCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ConsumerAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(consumerSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            net80References.Concat(messagePackReferences).Append(externalReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(consumerCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? externalEnumSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"ExternalLib.ExternalEnum\");\n        Assert.NotNull(externalEnumSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(externalEnumSymbol!.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        INamedTypeSymbol targetInterface = formatterInterface!.Construct(externalEnumSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? generatedFormatter = GetAllTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace)\n            .FirstOrDefault(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(targetInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));\n        Assert.NotNull(generatedFormatter);\n\n        bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = generatedFormatter!.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.True(hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage, $\"Expected generated formatter '{generatedFormatter.ToDisplayString()}' to carry ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n        SyntaxReference? formatterSyntaxRef = generatedFormatter.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.FirstOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterSyntaxRef);\n        string generatedFormatterText = (await formatterSyntaxRef!.GetSyntaxAsync()).SyntaxTree.GetText().ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedFormatterText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol deeper in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return deeper;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}
